# Independent P25 codeword fixtures

Packed dibits (MSB-first, four per byte) generated by unmodified third-party op25 `p25craft.py` from revision `71abcd0ead32f86f51615ea6cc8a6a4dba4c949a`:
https://github.com/boatbod/op25/blob/71abcd0ead32f86f51615ea6cc8a6a4dba4c949a/op25/gr-op25_repeater/apps/tx/p25craft.py

Generator SHA-256: `27079a321f75bda5db8d3ef6dd30d65992dbf8b6c73a2c608b43f3f745e9e2d9`.

The external Python generator was executed once for fixture creation; no Python code is shipped or invoked by the PWN decoder/tests. These are independently encoded **synthetic codewords**, not captured RF. IQ tests synthesize ideal C4FM from those codewords.

Commands (against the independently downloaded generator):

```
python3 p25craft.py --tsdu --ntsbk 3 --nac 0x293 --ss 1 --opcode 0 --arg 0x00100123456789ab -o tsdu3.bin
python3 p25craft.py --updu --nac 0x293 --ss 1 --sapid 4 --src 0x123456 --length 13 --data 0x0102030405060708090a0b0c0d -o updu.bin
```

`--src` does not set UPDU LLID in this generator; its actual header has LLID 000001 (default destination), as verified in the printed output.

| Fixture | SHA-256 | Independently printed expected fields |
|---|---|---|
| tsdu3.bin | 78631acc4074c19642bdb566bba0a81804755d1b6a7a9c8e86624cd7dfeb51fc | Two `000000100123456789AB02E1` blocks, then `800000100123456789ABE6D5`; NAC 293 |
| updu.bin | c1aebbe94cf1510a2bb19b29ecc8786289d0a64aa0e1267ddbafbd04c12de856 | Header `15C40000000182070000CA0C`, two blocks, seven pad bytes, packet CRC F9248547, payload 0102030405060708090A0B0C0D |

Supported: centered Phase-1 C4FM TSDU 1..3 TSBKs (`mode: :tsbk`) and unconfirmed rate-1/2 PDU format 0x15 (`mode: :pdu`; `:all` enables both). NID BCH/parity, header/TSBK CRC16 and full padded PDU CRC32 verified; trellis Viterbi correction. PDU SAP 0/4 clear bytes, SAP 9 ciphertext, unknown SAP opaque bytes with unknown encryption state. No voice/HDU/LDUs, CQPSK, Phase 2, confirmed 3/4-rate PDU, AMBT, frequency acquisition, or decryption. No sustained realtime claim.
